rationale: The short breakdown thesis has failed as price has steadily climbed across five consecutive 1-minute green candles and reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($183.67). With the current ask at $183.90 sitting directly on our invalidation level and a wide 29.4 bps spread with only 23 minutes left in the session, closing immediately preserves the remaining daily loss budget against adverse momentum. Flipping to long is unattractive given the wide bid-ask spread and strong overhead resistance from the broader intraday downtrend and session VWAP ($186.49).
